subject: Edge segmentation onboarding & term alignment for renewal
messages:
From: Alyssa Reed <alyssa.reed@orbisfin.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@orbisfin.com>, procurement@orbisfin.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal — new isolated VPC + on-prem edge ask

Hi Logan,

Hope you’re well. As we approach our renewal window (end of year), we’re evaluating a change to how Orbis uses Redwood for latency-sensitive workloads. Two asks coming out of infra and compliance:

1) Stand up a dedicated isolated VPC environment for our production tenant (same region, different VPC/subnet) — this is for stricter network segmentation and auditability.
2) Add a small on-prem edge node cluster (3 nodes) to sit in our data center for sub-100ms tail latencies for trading batch enrichment.

We expect to renew the current contract but will need a term amendment to capture the add-on capacity and an updated SLA/price sheet. Attached is a rough network diagram and a proposed scope doc.

Can Redwood provide an estimated timeline, one-time provisioning cost, and the delta to committed throughput pricing (we’re currently on a dedicated 120k tokens/day commitment)? Also please flag any compliance or HSM/KMS constraints for the on-prem piece.

Thanks — cc’ing Samir (infra) and Procurement.

—Alyssa
Alyssa Reed
CTO, Orbis Financial
alyssa.reed@orbisfin.com
+1 415 555 0124

Attachment: orbis-network-diagram.png (PNG, 220kb)
Attachment: ORB-Orbis-proposed-scope-v1.docx (DOCX, 180kb)

From: logan.wright@redwood.com <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Reed <alyssa.reed@orbisfin.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@orbisfin.com>, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal — new isolated VPC + on-prem edge ask

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear brief and the diagrams, very helpful.

Short answers up front:
- We can support an isolated VPC (same region) and pin a dedicated cluster to that environment. Typical provisioning time is 3–5 weeks for VPC network setup + validation.
- On-prem edge cluster: we can ship a 3-node lightweight inference cluster (quantized) that integrates with your KMS/HSM. There are two integration patterns (managed tunnel back to Redwood control plane or fully air-gapped with exported metrics via SFTP). We’ll need a short security questionnaire to pick the right pattern.
- Pricing: I’ll pull a delta quote (one-time provisioning + monthly capacity + amended committed commit). Expect a ballpark within 48 hours; final numbers after infra specs.

I’ve attached a preliminary estimate (redwood-quote-0892.xlsx) and looped in Neha (technical lead for private deployments) and Marcus (solutions lead) to scope the provisioning plan and compliance checklist.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call Thursday 11/12 or Friday 11/13 to walk through the network diagram and the on-prem constraints?

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 650 555 3482

Attachment: redwood-quote-0892.xlsx (XLSX, draft)

Subject: Fwd: Renewal — new isolated VPC + on-prem edge ask

Forwarding Alyssa’s note with initial comments:

Quick technical notes for scoping:
- VPC: We'll need the Orbis CIDR plan and route table boundaries; expect two weeks for network ops coordination (AZ subnets + peering).
- Dedicated cluster: Recommend reserving a mixed GPU pool (1 x a2-high or similar + 1 x a1 for fallback) for predictable throughput. We should size the KV cache to the 95th percentile seq length — ask Samir for typical prompt/seq distributions.
- Edge cluster: 3-node footprint looks right; request for approximate rack space/power and public IP egress rules. For HSM integration, we'll require a short PKI handoff and a test certificate.

I can draft the technical appendix for the scope doc; Marcus can own delivery timeline and resource allocations.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Lead PM, Private Deployments
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Renewal — new isolated VPC + on-prem edge ask

Neha — thanks, adding a few delivery details so we can give Orbis a concrete timeline during the call:
- Week 0: Contract amendment drafted (account + legal) and a statement of work (SoW) appendix for the VPC + edge nodes.
- Week 1–2: Network coordination and KMS/HSM exchange; procurement completes PO.
- Week 3–4: Provision VPC and deploy dedicated cluster; smoke tests.
- Week 5: Ship edge nodes for on-prem; 1-week onsite validation and handover.

We should propose a 12-month minimum term for the edge nodes (hardware provisioning) with a 30% uplift on the committed monthly token rate for the first 6 months while the cache warms. After month 6, revert to the negotiated committed rate.

Rishi — can you confirm whether the uplift percentage above aligns with previous offers (we recommended 25–35% for similar setups)?

Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Alyssa — thanks again for the call last week. Circling back with the consolidated proposal and next steps.

Summary:
- Provisioning: Isolated VPC (production tenant), dedicated cluster pinned to that VPC, and a 3-node on-prem edge cluster shipped to your DC. Target start: Week of 2026-12-14; provisioning complete by 2027-01-18.
- Commercials: One-time provisioning & hardware logistics = $48,000 (quoted in attached XLSX). Monthly committed delta = +30% on your current committed token rate for the first 6 months while the cache and model optimizations ramp; thereafter the committed rate returns to standard terms. Minimum term for the edge hardware is 12 months.
- Compliance: We will support HSM integration (customer-managed HSM) and provide a SOC-compliant runbook. If you select air-gapped mode, the handover timeline adds ~1 week for certificate exchange and validation.

Requested next steps:
1) Procurement to confirm PO by 2026-12-10 (email acceptance or send PO).
2) Sign the contract amendment (DocuSign link below).
3) Samir to share CIDR plan and on-prem rack/power details by 2026-12-08 so Neha can finalize the SoW appendix.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-orbis-0892
Redwood deal page: https://app.redwood.com/deals/RDW-DEAL-2026-0892

If that timeline and uplift look reasonable, I’ll ask Legal to draft the amendment and send the DocuSign envelope. Happy to hop on a quick call if Procurement or Infra have follow-ups.

Best,
